title: Cheese Ravioli with Fennel and Tarragon Pesto
changes_from_base: Blanched fennel, tarragon, parsley, lemon and parmesan are blended into a nut-free pesto that replaces the butter sauce, with shop-bought cheese ravioli in place of homemade.
summary: Tender cheese ravioli dressed in a fresh green pesto of blanched fennel, tarragon and parsley.

ingredients.item: fennel bulb, stalks removed, halved, cored and cut into 5 mm pieces
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt, for the cooking water

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Set around 4000 ml water boiling in a large pot.

steps.title: Blanch
steps.text: Simmer 1 fennel bulb, chopped into 5 mm pieces, for 2-3 min until softened, scoop it into a colander and refresh under cold water; next drop in 2 unpeeled garlic cloves for 1 min and cool them the same way.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Tip 680 g cheese ravioli into the pot with 1 tbsp salt and cook to al dente, stirring frequently; reserve 120 ml of the water, then drain and return them to the pot.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Peel and chop the blanched garlic, then blitz it with the fennel, 15 g parsley, 15 g tarragon, 2 tbsp lemon juice and 40 g parmesan in 20-30 pulses until finely ground.

steps.title: Stream
steps.text: Keep the motor going and trickle in 60 ml olive oil, then finish with ¼ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Fold the ravioli gently into about 240 ml of the fennel-tarragon pesto, slackening with cooking water a tablespoon at a time, and pass the rest at the table.

tips: Cool the fennel and garlic quickly under cold water to keep the pesto vivid.
Thin the pesto with reserved cooking water so it clings to every parcel.
safety: Check the ravioli label for egg.
storage: Keep leftover pesto chilled under a film of oil for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
